t: What Electrical Grid Dependency Database Is All About
title: What Electrical Grid Dependency Database Is All About
description: Grid dependencies are the hidden wiring: generators depend on fuel delivery, substations on protection relays, distribution on transmission, and everything on communications. The 2003 Northeast blackout (55M people) cascaded from one Ohio utility's tree-trimming failure through uncoordinated relays. N-1 contingency analysis asks: can the grid survive any single failure? Map the dependencies before the cascade maps them for you. This database is the complete grid dependency: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
